competitors.name: The Marzetti Company / New York Bakery
competitors.action: The Marzetti Company announced three New York Bakery frozen product platforms: Baked Bites, Cheesy Focaccia and Garlic Bread loaves. Baked Bites move the frozen-bread brand into the frozen snacks and appetizers aisle for the first time, with Garlic & Cheese and Jalapeño Cheddar Cheese varieties that can be prepared in an air fryer and provide up to 8 grams of protein per serving.

trends.topic: Frozen-bread brands expanding into pizza-adjacent snacking and shareable meal occasions
trends.magnitude: New York Bakery introduced three frozen platforms spanning two filled-snack flavors, two shareable focaccia varieties and two garlic-bread loaves; Baked Bites are the brand's first products in the frozen snacks aisle.
trends.context: This is a manufacturer announcement, and retailer availability varies. The portfolio move is nevertheless operationally relevant: a leading frozen-bread brand is using air-fryer preparation, protein and shareable formats to compete across snack, entertaining and family-meal occasions adjacent to premium frozen pizza. Real Dough should expect more freezer-aisle competition from brands stretching beyond their legacy category rather than only from pizza labels.

breaking.headline: The Marzetti Company Expands New York Bakery Portfolio with New Baked Bites, Cheesy Focaccia, and Garlic Bread Loaves
